working_on.notes: Floating widget successfully injects into all pages via Shadow DOM. CORS bypass implemented using background service worker.

recent_changes.description: Injected #modal-dca and #modal-close into Shadow DOM to fix Uncaught TypeError inside widget. Bound click events directly in content.js.
Resolved CORS policy block by delegating fetchPricesMap to background.js when executed in content script context.
Created and styled global floating widget using content.js and Shadow DOM.

errors_encountered.error: Failed to fetch style.css in strict CSP environments
errors_encountered.solution: Replaced fetch(cssUrl) with a standard <link rel="stylesheet"> injected into Shadow DOM

errors_encountered.error: CORS policy block for TradingView scanner API from Gemini page
errors_encountered.solution: Implemented a message passing proxy via background.js to fetch prices from content script

errors_encountered.error: Cannot set properties of null (setting 'innerHTML') at dca-title
errors_encountered.solution: Injected DCA and Close Modal HTML directly into widgetHtml inside content.js

decisions_made.decision: Use Shadow DOM for the floating widget
decisions_made.reason: Ensure perfect CSS isolation so extension styles don't conflict with host websites.
Bypass host website CORS restrictions for content scripts.
Avoid pulling the heavy popup.js UI bindings, keep the widget quick and simple while maintaining core interaction.
